relations.rationale: Bo and Uma's birdwatching enthusiasm has no bearing on the age comparison between Cleo and Bo.
Eagerness to spot herons is unrelated to Cleo's ranking of the walk's quality.
If Bo is on the same team as Uma, this doesn't determine whether Uma and Jude are on the same team.
If Bo is on the same team as Uma, and Bo is not on the same team as Jude, this is consistent but doesn't directly support or contradict; A doesn't establish B, but is compatible with it.
Noor being tallest supports the claim that Noor stands a head above Jude, especially if Jude is short.
Noor being tallest is consistent with Jude being shortest but doesn't itself establish it.
Noor's height has no bearing on the group pausing near a river bend.
Noor's height is unrelated to the number of species counted by midday.
Noor standing a head above Jude supports Jude being the shortest by a noticeable margin.
Height difference between Noor and Jude has no bearing on team assignments.
Height comparison is unrelated to the location of the group's pause.
Height difference between Noor and Jude has no bearing on Cleo's ranking of the walk.
Cleo being older than Uma doesn't determine her age relative to Bo.
Cleo being slightly older than Uma has no direct bearing on Uma's age relative to Bo.
Cleo being younger than Bo doesn't determine Uma's age relative to Bo.
Cleo's age relative to Bo has no bearing on her ranking of the walk's quality.
Uma's age relative to Bo has no bearing on Noor's notebook activity.
Team assignments between Uma and Jude have no bearing on the group's location near the river bend.
Uma not being on Jude's team doesn't directly establish or negate Bo's team relation to Jude.
Pausing near a river bend has no direct bearing on Jude spotting a woodpecker in an oak tree.
